apple.name: Pack One
apple.subtitle: Daily Limited Draft Challenge
apple.promotionalText: Three new Dailies every day. Eight picks each. What would you take? See what the trophy drafter chose and how your pick scored.
apple.description:
Would you make the same pick as a trophy drafter?

Pack One is a daily Limited draft game built around first-pack decisions from real trophy drafts. You'll see each pack and the cards the original drafter had already picked. Make your choice before the reveal.

Then see what the trophy drafter took and how the model scored the alternatives. A matching pick earns 100 points, but a different card can still get partial credit. The drafter isn't always right.

Three new Dailies every day:
- Daily Draft Run
- Daily Powered Cube
- Daily Latest Set

Everyone gets the same decisions in each Daily, so you can compare scores on the leaderboards.

Want more drafts? Regular Draft Run practice is free. A free Pack One account saves your results, tracks your career, and keeps your progress available on iPhone, iPad, and packone.pro. Elite adds Powered Cube and custom-set practice.

You can play all three Dailies without an account.

- Daily Draft Run
- Daily Powered Cube

Regular Draft Run practice is free between Dailies. A free Pack One account saves your results, tracks your career, and keeps your results available on other devices and packone.pro. Optional Elite adds Powered Cube and custom-set practice.
